profiles.name: Prosecution Protocols
chars: Ranged weapons that models in this unit are equipped with can target a PSYKER CHARACTER even if it is not the closest enemy unit.

rules.name: Psychic Abomination
rules.text: This model can never be targeted or affected by psychic powers. When a Psychic test or a Deny the Witch test is taken for an enemy model, subtract 1 from the total for each unit from your army with this ability within 18" of that model (to a maximum of -4).

rules.name: Witch Hunters
rules.text: When resolving an attack made with a melee weapon by a model in this unit against a PSYKER unit, you cna re-roll the wound roll.

rules.name: Null Maidens
rules.text: If you have an IMPERIUM Warlord (excluding a FALLEN warlord), you can include this unit in a Vanguard Detachment. If you do so, that Detachment's HQ requirements are changed to 0-2 and its Command Benefits are changed to "None".

profiles.name: Psyk-Out Grenades
chars: When resolving an attack made with this weapon against a PSYKER or DAEMON unit, a hit roll of 6+ inflicts a mortal wound on the target and the attack sequence ends.

profiles.name: R1: Sharpshooters
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for this unit in the Shooting phase.

profiles.name: R1: Agile
chars: You can re-roll Advance and Charge rolls for this unit.

profiles.name: R1: Deadeye Shots
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified wound roll of 6 for an attack with one of this unit’s ranged weapons, increase the Damage characteristic of that attack by 1.

profiles.name: R1: Grizzled
chars: This unit ignores penalties to their Leadership characteristic.

profiles.name: R2: Combat Specialists
chars: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for this unit in the Fight phase.

profiles.name: R2: Assassins
chars: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by models in this unit that target an enemy CHARACTER unit.

profiles.name: R3: Trophy Takers
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

profiles.name: R4: Disciplined
chars: This unit can shoot or charge during a turn in which it Fell Back.

profiles.name: R5: Brutal
chars: Add 1 to the Strength and Attacks characteristic of models in this unit during any turn in which they made a successful charge move.

profiles.name: R2: Lucky
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model from this unit loses a wound; on a 6 the model does not lose that wound.

profiles.name: R3: Breachers
chars: Add 1 to wound rolls for attacks made by models in this unit if the target of those attacks is receiving the benefit of cover.

profiles.name: R1: Unstoppable Beast
chars: After this model completes a charge move, roll a D6 for each enemy unit within 1" of it. On a 4+ that unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

profiles.name: R1: Monstrous Regeneration
chars: This model regains 1 lost wound at the start of each of your turns.

profiles.name: R2: Terrifying
chars: Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 6" of this model.

profiles.name: R2: Lashing Limbs
chars: Each time you roll an unmodified saving throw of 6 for this model in the Fight phase, the enemy unit that made that attack suffers 1 mortal wound after it has resolved all of its attacks.

profiles.name: R3: Inhuman Resilience
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model in this unit loses a wound; on a 5+ the model does not lose that wound

profiles.name: R3: Sweeping Blows
chars: Each unmodified hit roll of 6 made for this model’s attacks in the Fight phase score 2 hits instead of 1.

profiles.name: R4: Juggernaut
chars: You can re-roll charge rolls for this model.

profiles.name: R5: Just Making it Angry
chars: If this model has a damage table, double the number of wounds it has remaining for the purposes of determining what its Strength and Attacks characteristics are.

profiles.name: R5: Eager
chars: At the start of the first battle round but before the first turn begins, you can move this model up to 5". It cannot end this move within 9" of any enemy models. If both players have units that can do this, the player who is taking the first turn moves their units first.

profiles.name: R1: Famed Commander
chars: Roll a D6 each time a model in this unit loses a wound; on a 6 the model does not lose that wound.

chars: Select one of the ranged weapons used by one or more models in this unit. Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of that weapon for attacks made by that unit.

profiles.name: R2: Advanced Targeting
chars: Add 6" to the maximum range of this unit’s Heavy and Rapid Fire weapons that have an unmodified maximum range of 24" or longer.

profiles.name: R3: Ablative Armor
chars: Attacks against this unit that have an AP characteristic of -1 are treated as having an AP characteristic of 0 instead.

profiles.name: R3: Storied Vehicle
chars: You can re-roll one hit roll or wound roll for this unit in each of your Shooting phases.

profiles.name: R4: Blessed Drive
chars: If this model has a damage table, double the number of wounds it has remaining for the purposes of determining what its Move characteristic is.

profiles.name: R4: Last Resort
chars: If a model in this unit is destroyed, the controlling player can choose for it to automatically explode – no dice roll is required.

profiles.name: R5: Prominent Trophy
chars: Add 1 to the Leadership characteristic of friendly units while they are within 6" of this unit. Subtract 1 from the Leadership characteristic of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

profiles.name: R5: Blessed Weapons
chars: If this model has a damage table, double the number of wounds it has remaining for the purposes of determining what its Ballistic Skill characteristic is.
